# CDR highlights arbitration experts roundtable from the Burford Quarterly


- International arbitration


January 16, 2025


-
-
-
-


*CDR Magazine* covers key takeaways from a recent roundtable of next-gen arbitration leaders from the latest issue of the *[Burford Quarterly](https://www.burfordcapital.com/insights-news-events/burford-quarterly/2025-issue-1/international-arbitration-in-london-roundtable/)* .


The article quotes Dr. Conway Blake on the legal finance industry: "The availability of litigation funding is key to the access and equity of any sophisticated legal system."
